description: Path of Exile contrast: farm a 2% unique (Dissolution of the Flesh, community estimate for regular Searing Exarch in 3.26.0) under a weak Beta prior, then a later known opportunity. Retry and travel times are illustrative (same scale as H5 v2), not timed from PoE footage. Rewards are points, not Chaos prices — the dated snapshot has null prices on purpose.
